en.v: We shouldn’t hurry all the way to the airport, the flight was

examples.zh: 我们不应该急着去机场，因为有雾，航班被取消了。

errata.original: We shouldn’t hurry all the way to the airport, the flight <u>was</u> cancelled because of the foggy weather.
errata.corrected: We shouldn’t hurry all the way to the airport, the flight was <u>cancelled</u> because of the foggy weather.
errata.note: 例句下划线印在 was 下，应标在词条词形 cancelled 下；经人工复核（GitHub #135 第 11 条）确认更正
